name: BetItalyPay
note: Payments and top-up services brand (game-account top-ups, bill payments, betting-point services) run by GI.LU.PI. S.r.l. a S.U. of Tricase (Lecce). Lecce's co-sponsor/second sponsor since 2022; renewed for 2026-27 and, per PianetaLecce (5 Aug 2026), for three more years. Founder Giuseppe Pandinelli is named in press coverage (PianetaLecce, 5 Aug 2026), but the company's shareholder isn't published, so ownership rests on the brand's own site footer.
